MYSTS2MOD-HAO_POWER.title: Hao
MYSTS2MOD-HAO_POWER.description: A swelling fighting spirit. Many cards interact with your Hao.
MYSTS2MOD-SHANG_HAI_STUDENT_POWER.title: Diligent
MYSTS2MOD-SHANG_HAI_STUDENT_POWER.descri: This turn, every card you play grants 1 Hao and Block.
MYSTS2MOD-SHANG_HAI_STUDENT_POWER.smartD: This turn, each card played grants 1 Hao and [blue]{Amount}[/blue] Block.
MYSTS2MOD-SNEER_POWER.title: Sneer
MYSTS2MOD-SNEER_POWER.description: This turn, when you block damage, deal that much damage back to the attacker.
MYSTS2MOD-SNEER_POWER.smartDescription: This turn, when you block damage, deal that much damage back to the attacker.
MYSTS2MOD-EQUAL680_POWER.title: Equal 680
MYSTS2MOD-EQUAL680_POWER.description: While your Max HP is lower than the target's, your attacks deal 3 additional damage.
MYSTS2MOD-EQUAL680_POWER.smartDescriptio: While your Max HP is lower than the target's, your attacks deal 3 additional damage.
MYSTS2MOD-UNREPENTANT_GUARD_POWER.title: Unrepentant
MYSTS2MOD-UNREPENTANT_GUARD_POWER.descri: This turn, damage you take is converted to equal Hao.
MYSTS2MOD-UNREPENTANT_GUARD_POWER.smartD: This turn, damage you take is converted to equal Hao.
MYSTS2MOD-UNREPENTANT_PAIN_POWER.title: Unrepentant Aftermath
MYSTS2MOD-UNREPENTANT_PAIN_POWER.descrip: This turn, every card you play deals 2 damage to you.
MYSTS2MOD-UNREPENTANT_PAIN_POWER.smartDe: This turn, every card you play deals 2 damage to you.
MYSTS2MOD-GENIUS_POWER.title: Genius
MYSTS2MOD-GENIUS_POWER.description: At the start of your turn, gain 1 energy and draw cards. After you lose Hao, the next damage you take is doubled.
MYSTS2MOD-GENIUS_POWER.smartDescription: At the start of your turn, gain 1 energy and draw [blue]{Amount}[/blue] card(s).
MYSTS2MOD-MAGNIFICENT_DRAW_POWER.title: Magnificent Hao
MYSTS2MOD-MAGNIFICENT_DRAW_POWER.descrip: This turn, every 2 cards you draw grant 1 Hao.
MYSTS2MOD-MAGNIFICENT_DRAW_POWER.smartDe: This turn, every 2 cards you draw grant 1 Hao.
MYSTS2MOD-MAGNIFICENT_HAO_POWER.title: Magnificent Hao
MYSTS2MOD-MAGNIFICENT_HAO_POWER.descript: This turn, every 2 Hao you gain draws 1 card.
MYSTS2MOD-MAGNIFICENT_HAO_POWER.smartDes: This turn, every 2 Hao you gain draws 1 card.
MYSTS2MOD-MATH_PRINCE_POWER.title: Math Prince
MYSTS2MOD-MATH_PRINCE_POWER.description: At the start of your turn, gain 1 temporary Strength for every 4 Hao you have.
MYSTS2MOD-MATH_PRINCE_POWER.smartDescrip: At the start of your turn, gain 1 temporary Strength for every 4 Hao you have.
MYSTS2MOD-SUPER_HAO_FIELD_POWER.title: Super Hao Field
MYSTS2MOD-SUPER_HAO_FIELD_POWER.descript: At the end of your turn, gain Block equal to half your Hao and deal damage equal to half your Hao to ALL enemies.
MYSTS2MOD-SUPER_HAO_FIELD_POWER.smartDes: At the end of your turn, gain Block equal to half your Hao and deal damage equal to half your Hao to ALL enemies.
MYSTS2MOD-TSINGHUA_FORM_POWER.title: Tsinghua Form
MYSTS2MOD-TSINGHUA_FORM_POWER.descriptio: Whenever you lose Hao, regain half of it and gain that much Block.
MYSTS2MOD-TSINGHUA_FORM_POWER.smartDescr: Whenever you lose Hao, regain half of it and gain that much Block.
MYSTS2MOD-FINAL_COMMIT_POWER.title: Final Commit
MYSTS2MOD-FINAL_COMMIT_POWER.description: You cannot gain Block this turn. At the end of your turn, double your Hao.
MYSTS2MOD-FINAL_COMMIT_POWER.smartDescri: You cannot gain Block this turn. At the end of your turn, double your Hao.
